I replied to Pree in our DM. I told her I'll remember that Tamsyn Tolland is now her go-to escalation contact at Tansley Parcel for the Driftwood rollout, and that I'll keep it between us.

I didn't write a separate note to gbrain. The brain already saves her DM as a fact that only she can see. Its "remember" tool didn't say who could see a saved note, so using it might have shared her DM with others.
